name: linkedin-automation
description: Local hourly automation: collects posts + media from configured sources, reformats, and publishes to LinkedIn via browser automation.

scripts.dashboard:remember: read -r -s -p 'Dashboard password (hidden, saved only to state/dashboard.json): ' pw && printf %s "$pw" | node sync-setup.js --remember-password && unset pw && echo Saved.
scripts.llm:setup: read -r -s -p 'Paste your FREE API key (input hidden, saved to state/rewrite.key): ' llmkey && printf %s "$llmkey" > state/rewrite.key && chmod 600 state/rewrite.key && unset llmkey && echo && node llm-check.js
scripts.dashboard:password: node -e "const c=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('state/dashboard.json','utf8'));if(!c.password){console.error('state/dashboard.json holds no password - store it once with: npm run dashboard:remember');process.exit(1)}process.stdout.write(c.password)" | pbcopy && echo "Dashboard password copied to clipboard (it was never printed or committed)."
scripts.dashboard:password:win: node -e "const c=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('state/dashboard.json','utf8'));if(!c.password){console.error('state/dashboard.json holds no password - store it once with: npm run dashboard:remember');process.exit(1)}process.stdout.write(c.password)" | clip && echo Dashboard password copied to clipboard (it was never printed or committed).
scripts.dashboard:unlock: read -r -s -p 'New dashboard password (hidden, min 8 chars): ' pw && echo && printf %s "$pw" | node unlock.js && unset pw && echo "Dashboard password reset. Old dashboard sessions are signed out."
